summary: US restocks keep shrinking and vanish in about a minute, but Fifth Avenue popped overnight; keep the 9-11:30 AM window sharp and act on every alert, even at 1 AM.

items.title: Fifth Avenue had a 256GB Night Sky around 1:09 AM Friday
items.summary: A brief overnight wave (about 1:05-1:10 AM ET Oct 30) also hit Queens Center and Pheasant Lane; each lasted roughly a minute. US drops fell to ~380 Thursday from 595.

items.title: Report: most launch stock went to stores, Fifth Avenue got extra
items.summary: Per Bloomberg's Gurman, about 80% of initial Duos were sent to retail; smaller stores got ~50 units, flagships ~250, and Fifth Avenue notably more.

items.title: Online orders still quote late January delivery
items.summary: Apple's site has pointed US online Duo orders to around January 25, so in-store pickup restocks remain the fastest way to get one.
